strings.zh: 初次见面！这里是Ｇｌｏｂａｌ{NEWLINE}　Ｔｒａｄｅ　Ｃｅｎｔｅｒ{CLEAR}简称ＧＴＣ！{SCROLL}这里是利用{NEWLINE}ＷｉーＦｉ连接,{SCROLL}与素未谋面的人{NEWLINE}交换精灵的地方,{SCROLL}要与全世界的训练家{NEWLINE}进行精灵交换吗？
strings.en: Nice to meet you! This is the Global{NEWLINE}Trade Center, or GTC for short!{SCROLL}This is where you can use a Wi-Fi{NEWLINE}connection to trade Pokémon with people{CLEAR}you’ve never met.{SCROLL}Would you like to trade Pokémon with{NEWLINE}Trainers from all over the world?

strings.zh: 您好！{NEWLINE}欢迎来到ＧＴＣ！{SCROLL}要用ＷｉーＦｉ连接{NEWLINE}要与全世界的训练家{NEWLINE}进行精灵交换吗？
strings.en: Hello! Welcome to the GTC!{SCROLL}Would you like to use a Wi-Fi connection{NEWLINE}to trade Pokémon with Trainers from all{CLEAR}over the world?

strings.zh: ＧＴＣ是以存放精灵和搜索精灵{SCROLL}两种方式进行精灵交换,{SCROLL}需要详细说明吗？
strings.en: At the GTC, you can trade Pokémon in{NEWLINE}two ways: by depositing Pokémon and by{CLEAR}searching for Pokémon.{SCROLL}Would you like a detailed explanation?

strings.zh: 请客人先把要交换的{NEWLINE}精灵存放起来,{SCROLL}同时,客人可以先去查询{NEWLINE}想要的精灵,{SCROLL}在存放期间如果有符合条件的精灵{CLEAR}就可以进行交换,{SCROLL}需要其他详细说明吗？
strings.en: First, please deposit the Pokémon you{NEWLINE}want to trade.{SCROLL}At the same time, you can look up the{NEWLINE}Pokémon you would like.{SCROLL}If a Pokémon that meets your conditions{NEWLINE}turns up while yours is deposited, the{CLEAR}trade can go through.{SCROLL}Anything else you’d like to know about?

strings.zh: 我们可以从其他玩家{NEWLINE}存放的精灵里面{SCROLL}寻找想要的精灵,{SCROLL}在交换精灵的时候,{NEWLINE}用存放的精灵{CLEAR}去交换想要的精灵,{SCROLL}需要其他详细说明吗？
strings.en: You can look for the Pokémon you want{NEWLINE}among those other players deposited.{SCROLL}When you trade, you give your deposited{NEWLINE}Pokémon for the one you want.{SCROLL}Anything else you’d like to know about?

strings.zh: 要与全世界的训练家{NEWLINE}进行精灵交换吗？
strings.en: Would you like to trade Pokémon with{NEWLINE}Trainers from all over the world?

strings.zh: 好大的地球仪！{SCROLL}说起来,地球仪的仪{NEWLINE}是什么意思？
strings.en: What a huge globe!{SCROLL}Come to think of it, where does the word{NEWLINE}“globe” come from?

strings.zh: 通信对象的居住地址,{SCROLL}似乎都记录在这个地球仪上了！
strings.en: This globe seems to record where{NEWLINE}everyone you’ve linked with lives!

strings.zh: 在这里存放精灵的话,{NEWLINE}即便在我睡着的时候{CLEAR}说不定也能进行精灵交换！
strings.en: If I deposit a Pokémon here, maybe it{NEWLINE}can get traded even while I’m asleep!

strings.zh: 跟陌生人也能随便{NEWLINE}进行精灵交换,{CLEAR}这世界真厉害！
strings.en: You can easily trade Pokémon even with{NEWLINE}strangers. The world is amazing!

strings.zh: 这个地球仪可以把自己的{CLEAR}住址登录上去,{SCROLL}这样一来,在通信的时候{NEWLINE}就可让对方知道自己的住址！
strings.en: This globe lets you register{NEWLINE}where you live.{SCROLL}That way, when you link up, the other{NEWLINE}person can see where you live!

strings.zh: ＷｉーＦｉ连接很简单的吧？{SCROLL}那么我也要进行精灵交换了！
strings.en: Wi-Fi is easy to connect to, isn’t it?{SCROLL}All right, I’ll trade some Pokémon too!
